title: Railway hero
description: A framed, faintly navy hero panel over full-panel art: a big centred book-serif headline, one quiet line with an underlined link, a violet and a near-black button, then a near-black app window whose pill tab bar overlaps its bottom edge. The tabs take turns on their own with a violet progress fill sweeping across the active one; the art drifts sideways as the hero scrolls away.
notes: background and each tab's media are slots; empty ones show a soft gradient and a near-black window
the app window and tabs show from tablets up; phones get the headline and buttons only, like the original
needs JavaScript for the auto-advancing tabs (hydrate: load); reduced motion keeps the first tab
name: railway-hero
